mapper.select: SELECT code, name, market, sector FROM stock_master WHERE name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%') ORDER BY CASE WHEN name = #{q} THEN 0 WHEN name ILIKE CONCAT(#{q}, '%') THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, name LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO stock_master (code, name, market, sector, updated_at) VALUES
(#{v.code}, #{v.name}, #{v.market}, #{v.sector}, NOW())
ON CONFLICT (code) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name, market = EXCLUDED.market, sector = EXCLUDED.sector, updated_at = NOW()
